title: A High-Order Finite Volume GENO Scheme with Implicit Time Integration for Three-Temperature Radiation Diffusion Equations
summary: This study presents a high-order finite volume scheme capable of large time-step integration for three-temperature radiation diffusion (3TRD) equations, where conservation is naturally achieved through energy update. To handle local large gradients and discontinuities in temperature, a central generalized ENO (GENO) reconstruction is developed for diffusion systems, which achieves essentially non-oscillatory reconstruction for discontinuous solutions.
